topic.title: Sharing SoC Thermal Solution with Other High-Power Components like dGFX

body.p: When designing with other high-power components (such as discrete graphics), take into consideration the following thermal solution recommendations:

ul.li:
Recommendation #1: Share heat-pipes bi-directionally
Using shared heat-pipes between SoC and dGFX provides the ability to share unused thermal capacity from one package to the other, thereby maximizing both SoC and dGFX sustained performance.
Shared heat-pipes also provide better transient thermal capacity for both SoC and dGFX packages

Recommendation #2: Ensure heat pipe routing covers both SoC and dGFX hot spots
Thermal considerations should be made to ensure dGFX memory and VRs are cooled when necessary

Recommendation #3: Enable Adaptix/DTT power sharing policies to manage power dissipation capability of shared heat-pipes
DTT power sharing policies (PS2, TPG) optimize performance by dynamically balancing power for each component

Recommendation #4: Assess total system power capability for SoC + dGFX jointly depending on the system market target:
For cost-optimized systems consider: 80% * (Nominal TGP+ Processor Base Power)
For premium systems consider: 90%* (Boost TGP+ Processor Base Power)
